title: Direct Preference Optimization with Unobserved Preference Heterogeneity: The Necessity of Ternary Preferences

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment fairness by measuring worst-case regret and max-mean reward margins across simulated annotator sub-populations from different countries (Britain, Indonesia, Mexico, Pakistan) using the GlobalOpinionQA dataset.
Measuring reward margins and worst-case regret across different simulated user subgroups defined by synthetic personality profiles (based on OCEAN traits) using the MPI dataset.
